title: Chip design software leader Synopsys says it is exploring partnerships with Chinese AI labs to develop AI-powered chip design tools for the Chinese market (Yifan Yu/Nikkei Asia)
summary: Yifan Yu / Nikkei Asia: Chip design software leader Synopsys says it is exploring partnerships with Chinese AI labs to develop AI-powered chip design tools for the Chinese market — PALO ALTO, California — Chip design software leader Synopsys says it is looking to help Chinese companies develop chips faster …
